approval_scope: Displayed roleplay and functional copy; active temporary buff reflecting direct melee damage; 30 percent at effective rank 11 and 31 percent at rank 12; duration 5 turns, energy 15, cooldown 10. Reflection uses actual damage received after protections; incoming damage remains; reflected damage applies directly without another defense reduction. Poison, bleeding and all indirect damage excluded; reflection cannot trigger reflection.
illustrative_profile: Rank 11 = 9 learned + 2 equipment; next rank 12 = 10 learned + 2 equipment, fixed other modifiers.
unshown_rules: Formula across all ranks, rounding, lethal order, mixed magical melee components, source eligibility, recast and stacking remain pending.
